why: phase-417 W4.e -- the node-bound form of `rust:Executor::register_guard_condition`, and the one place the binding is done, so `Node::create_guard_condition` is a forwarder rather than a second implementation. `node_id == None` is exactly the old behaviour, which is why the nodeless spelling survives as a call to this one. rclrs has neither: its guard condition comes from a `Context` and goes into a wait set (`cpp:WaitSet`). The `_on` suffix is this tree's existing spelling for "the same registrar, bound to a node" -- `register_timer_on`, `create_publisher_raw_on`, `declare_parameter_on`.
